title: Meet China

body.heading: Where in the world is China?
paragraphs: China is a country in Eastern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of China is Beijing.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in China is Chinese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of China is the Chinese yuan.

body.heading: How big is China?
paragraphs: China covers about 9,640,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the largest country in Asia. That makes it about three times the size of India.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Great Wall of China consists of many walls and fortifications built over centuries. If you joined every wall together, they would stretch more than halfway around the Earth. Guards once watched from its towers for invaders crossing the mountains.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Great Wall winds over mountains for thousands of kilometres. Families love the restored sections near Beijing, where you can walk the wall and ride a cable car up.
Thousands of life-size clay soldiers — each with a different face — have guarded the first emperor's tomb for over 2,000 years. The pits at Xi'an are astonishing.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find China on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: China in one breath: a country in Eastern Asia, capital Beijing, where people speak Chinese and pay with the Chinese yuan.
